The _amount parameter is consumed only by EDM.freePusher when building the freeStorage entry.
The _status parameter only selects the deposit or borrow branch inside EDM.freePusher.
The _amount parameter is the value subtracted without SafeMath, so it folds into the unchecked subtraction operation.
The _amount parameter only drives the matching loop of EDM.newOrder.
The _status parameter only picks the order side inside EDM.newOrder.
The _yield parameter is only compared against the pool head inside EDM.newOrder.
The _orderId parameter only identifies the entry written by EDM.matchOrder.
The to symbol parameter is only resolved to a real token inside Ecocelium.Withdraw.
The _amount parameter is only compared and forwarded inside Ecocelium.Withdraw.
The msgSender parameter is the recipient of the external transfers that make the ordering unsafe in Ecocelium._withdraw.
The amount parameter is only burned and paid out by Ecocelium._withdraw.
The rtoken parameter is only used to resolve the wrap symbol inside Ecocelium.Deposit.
The Address parameter is the value whitelisted by the broken owner check in EcoceliumInit.setFriendlyAddress.
The _orderId parameter only selects the matched order inside EDM.payDue.
The month parameter is only used in the delinquency comparison of EDM.dueCheck.
The dues accumulator is an internal temporary of EDM.freePopper and never escapes except as its return value.
The amountLeft counter is a loop-local of EDM.freePopper.
The amountLeft counter is a loop-local of EDM.newOrder.
The index local is a temporary pool cursor used only by EDM.newOrder.
The temp array is a memory buffer existing solely inside EDM.poolSorter.
The newAmount local is only computed and returned by EDM._ordersub.
The availableBalance local is only used for the branch decision inside Ecocelium.Withdraw.
The newAmount local is only used to size the payout inside Ecocelium._withdraw.
The time local is only used as the oracle delay inside EDM.scheduleExpiry.
The due local is only minted to the supplier inside EDM.dueCheck.
The wtoken local is only used as the wrap symbol inside Ecocelium._deposit.
